notes: hash_rate_hps is centered on ~0.98 ZH/s. bitops_per_hash is a low-level double-SHA-256 trial conversion. fleet_efficiency_j_per_th maps hashrate to mining electrical power; site_power_overhead_multiplier covers power supply, cooling, and facility overhead.

Power is site/system-scale for accelerator installations, not just chip TDP. ops_per_joule_at_peak is tensor-op throughput efficiency; utilization discounts peak specs to average realized operation rate.
A residual non-AI data-centre category. It converts facility power to IT power via PUE, applies a logic-compute fraction, then converts logic joules to one-bit primitive operations.
Network power is dominated by access and transmission infrastructure. Only the logic-processing fraction is counted as computation.

A broad installed-base category. Average logic power is averaged over wall-clock time, not just powered-on time. The associated-power multiplier accounts for display, power supply, memory/storage, and idle overhead.

Device count includes smartphones plus tablets/wearables. Average logic power is low because most devices are idle most of the day. associated_power_multiplier_vs_logic adds display/RF/charging/idle overhead.
MCUs, vehicles, appliances, industrial PLCs, sensors, payment terminals, building controls, etc. This placeholder is power-based now but should be split in the next revision.
TVs, streaming boxes, set-top boxes, image pipelines, security cameras, and similar fixed-function media hardware.
